rafa-eng: I can take the TF module. Will keep API minimal: region, profile, hsm. Plan to add a `canary` toggle and telemetry outputs.

mei-infra: Ops will own runbook + smoke tests. Which telemetry do you want surfaced? Datadog + metrics endpoint okay?

samir-sre: Datadog + prometheus scrape endpoint is fine. For HSM we should expose `kms_key_arn` and `hsm_provider`. Also add a CI acceptance test that does a dry HSM bind.

claire-marketing: Ill draft the partner blurb + Marketplace copy. Request partner logo + approved quote by Wed. Do we want embargo?

toni-partners: Tentative embargo until legal signs off. Timeline: module PR in 5d, Console quickstart 2d after merge, early access (10 customers) for 2w, public listing + blog 3w after EA.

rafa-eng: TF WIP (very small):
```hcl
module "bluehalo_onramp" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refkits/marketplace//bluehalo?ref=v0.1"
  region = var.region
  profile = var.node_profile
  hsm_enabled = var.hsm_enabled
  canary = var.enable_canary
}
```
Outputs: telemetry_endpoint, deploy_id.
